rules.alternatives: No CE hours for renewal. An APRN may practice only in the role and population focus in which they hold current national certification (ARM 24.159.1406), so national certification must be kept up.
rules.notes: Board repealed CE renewal rules (incl. APRN pharmacology hours) effective Nov 18, 2023. Renewal every 2 years by Dec 31 (odd or even year per licensee). Fee $50 per APRN certification type; prescriptive authority $75 + $60 MPDR fee.
rules.rule_quote: RESPONSE 6: The board is removing all CE requirements for renewal of LPN, RN, and APRN licensure.
